cities.name: Vilnius

interests.name: Old Town Culture 🎭
interests.description: Vilnius Old Town is one of the best-preserved medieval centers in Europe — cobbled streets, pastel buildings, cozy cafés and centuries of culture.

interests.name: Baroque Architecture 🏛️
interests.description: Cathedral Square and the surrounding churches represent Vilnius’s iconic baroque heritage. Grand facades and historic courtyards define the city’s style.

interests.name: Hilltop Views 🌅
interests.description: Gediminas Hill offers panoramic viewpoints over rooftops, forests and the river — breathtaking at sunset and a must-visit for photographers.

interests.name: Riverside Walks 🌊
interests.description: The Neris River Promenade creates calm routes ideal for slow walks, biking and enjoying peaceful urban nature.

interests.name: Local Food Exploration 😋
interests.description: Vilnius cuisine centers around potatoes, beet dishes, soups and pastries — simple, warm and deeply comforting.

cities.local_food_tip: Lithuanian comfort dishes like potato meals, veggie soups, beet salads and pastries — jednostavno i jako ukusno.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore Vilnius Old Town → walk to Cathedral Square (exterior) → cozy café break. Afternoon: Head up Gediminas Hill for views → walk along Neris Riverside → lunch: potato dishes, salads, veggie soups → visit creative Užupis district (exterior). Sunset: Enjoy golden light at Subačiaus Viewpoint. Night: Lantern-lit Old Town walk + dessert cafés.

places.name: Vilnius Old Town
places.description: One of Eastern Europe’s most charming medieval districts — cobblestones, churches, markets and vibrant cultural life.

places.name: Cathedral Square
places.description: The heart of Vilnius — framed by the Cathedral, the Bell Tower and monumental architecture.

places.name: Gediminas Castle Tower
places.description: Historic tower with panoramic views — ideal for sunrise and sunset.

places.name: Užupis District
places.description: Vilnius’s bohemian artistic quarter, known for street art, cafés and its playful 'constitution'.

places.name: Subačiaus Viewpoint
places.description: A stunning viewpoint overlooking rooftops, forests and winding streets.

hidden_gems.name: Bernardine Garden
hidden_gems.description: A peaceful riverside park with fountains, bridges and forest paths — perfect quiet escape.

hidden_gems.name: Literatų Street
hidden_gems.description: A tiny decorative alley covered with artistic plaques dedicated to writers.

hidden_gems.name: Hill of Three Crosses
hidden_gems.description: Another superb panorama point with forested surroundings.

ideas: ☕ Sunny terraces around Old Town cafés.
🍦 Ice cream walks through Old Town.
🍁 Old Town colors in narrow alleys.
🎄 Christmas Market in the Old Town.
🚶 Quiet winter strolls with soft lights.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚋 Trolleybuses cover most central and suburban districts.
🚌 City buses connect all areas including Old Town and Užupis.
🚶 Old Town is fully walkable and compact.
📱 Use TRAFI or JUDU apps for real-time schedules and ticket options.

city_events.name: Vilnius Festival
city_events.description: 🎶 Classical and modern performances in major venues across the city.

cities.name: Kaunas

interests.name: Old Town 🎭
interests.description: Kaunas Old Town is filled with charming streets, historic buildings, cozy cafés and vibrant cultural life.

interests.name: Riverside 🌊
interests.description: The Nemunas riverbank offers peaceful walks, open views and a refreshing connection to nature in the city.

interests.name: Art & Culture 🎨
interests.description: Kaunas embraces creativity with murals, street art yards, galleries and cultural districts.

cities.local_food_tip: Potato dishes, veggie soups, salads and pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore Kaunas Old Town → walk along Nemunas Riverside → enjoy a cozy local café. Afternoon: Discover Kaunas Art District → lunch with potato dishes or veggie soups → relax in Santaka Park. Sunset: Enjoy golden-hour views over the rivers. Night: Walk through lantern-lit Old Town streets.

places.name: Kaunas Old Town
places.description: Historic heart of the city with narrow streets, cafés, small shops and medieval atmosphere.

places.name: Nemunas Riverside
places.description: A beautiful riverside walk offering calm nature, open views and perfect photo spots.

places.name: Kaunas Street Art Yard
places.description: Colorful artistic courtyard filled with murals and creative installations.

places.name: Santaka Park
places.description: A peaceful green area at the meeting point of two rivers — perfect for long walks.

hidden_gems.name: Kaunas Castle
hidden_gems.description: A medieval red-brick fortress near the riverside — ideal for quiet exploration.

hidden_gems.name: Pažaislis Monastery
hidden_gems.description: A stunning baroque monastery surrounded by forest and lake landscapes.

hidden_gems.name: Aleksotas Viewpoint
hidden_gems.description: One of the best viewpoints in Kaunas with panoramic city and river views.

ideas: 🍦 Ice cream stops in Old Town.
🌇 Soft sunset light over Santaka Park.
🍁 Warm colors in Old Town streets.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 City buses cover all districts and tourist spots.
🚶 The city center and Old Town are easy to explore on foot.
📱 Use the Trafi app for tickets and routes.

city_events.name: Kaunas Jazz Festival
city_events.description: 🎷 One of the most important jazz festivals in the Baltic region.

cities.name: Klaipėda

interests.name: Seaside 🌊
interests.description: Klaipėda offers easy access to Baltic beaches, fresh sea air and relaxing coastal scenery. Smiltynė Beach is known for its soft sand and peaceful atmosphere. Perfect for morning walks, sunbathing or quiet sunset views.

interests.name: Old Town 🎭
interests.description: Klaipėda’s Old Town features timber-framed houses, narrow streets and cozy cafés. Its German-influenced architecture creates a unique Baltic charm. Ideal for slow strolls, photographs and cultural exploration.

interests.name: Harbor Walks 🚢
interests.description: The harbor promenade is perfect for maritime views, sea breeze and peaceful walks. Boats, docks and open waterfront make it one of the city’s signature areas. Great for morning or evening strolls.

cities.local_food_tip: Fresh coastal meals: veggie soups, salads, potatoes and Baltic pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Walk the Harbor Promenade → explore Old Town timber-framed streets → enjoy a cozy seaside café. Afternoon: Take the ferry to Smiltynė Beach → light lunch → relax on coastal forest paths. Sunset: Watch golden colors over the sand dunes. Night: Enjoy harbor lights and peaceful evening streets.

places.name: Klaipėda Old Town
places.description: Timber-framed houses, narrow lanes and cozy cafés give the Old Town its charming atmosphere.

places.name: Harbor Promenade
places.description: A scenic waterfront walk with ships, open views and refreshing sea breeze.

places.name: Smiltynė Beach
places.description: Soft sand, forest surroundings and calm coastline — one of the most relaxing Baltic beaches.

places.name: Dolphinarium & Sea Museum Ferry Area
places.description: A popular cultural area near the ferry with maritime exhibits and sea life attractions.

hidden_gems.name: Baltic Dune Trails (Smiltynė Forest Area)
hidden_gems.description: Quiet forest paths behind the dunes — peaceful, beautiful and ideal for nature lovers.

hidden_gems.name: Meridianas Ship
hidden_gems.description: A historic sailing ship docked in the city center — a unique symbol of Klaipėda.

hidden_gems.name: Castle Site & Surrounding Moats
hidden_gems.description: Quiet remains of Klaipėda Castle surrounded by calm water channels.

ideas: 🎨 Local art corners and cultural stops.
🌞 Crisp winter air on the shoreline.

public_transport_tips.tip: ⛴️ Ferries provide fast access to Smiltynė Beach and Curonian Spit.
🚌 Local buses connect districts across the city.
🚶 Old Town and harbor areas are very walkable.

city_events.name: Sea Festival
city_events.description: ⚓ A major maritime celebration with concerts, parades and seaside events.

cities.name: Palanga

interests.name: Beaches 🌊
interests.description: Palanga Beach is one of Lithuania’s most iconic seaside locations. Soft sand, long coastline, and refreshing Baltic waves make it perfect for walks and swimming. A must-visit spot for both sunrise and sunset views.

interests.name: Pine Forests 🌿
interests.description: Birutė Park surrounds visitors with peaceful pine forests, quiet paths, and small ponds. Designed as a historical landscape park, it offers calm nature moments close to the sea. Ideal for relaxation and scenic walks.

interests.name: Relaxed Coastal Streets 🎭
interests.description: The famous Basanavičiaus Street is filled with cafés, shops, music and seaside energy. It’s the social heart of Palanga and leads directly to the pier. A lively area perfect for evening strolls.

cities.local_food_tip: Fresh salads, soups, veggie meals and Baltic pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Start at Palanga Beach → walk into Birutė Park → relax in a cozy seaside café. Afternoon: Visit the exterior of the Palanga Amber Museum → enjoy a light lunch → stroll forest and dune paths. Sunset: Enjoy golden-hour views from the Palanga Pier. Night: Walk along the seaside promenade and Basanavičiaus Street under warm lights.

places.name: Palanga Beach
places.description: A long sandy beach with gentle dunes and refreshing Baltic Sea views.

places.name: Birutė Park
places.description: A serene pine forest park perfect for peaceful walks and nature relaxation.

places.name: Palanga Amber Museum
places.description: Located inside a historic manor, surrounded by beautiful botanical gardens.

places.name: Palanga Pier
places.description: One of Palanga’s most iconic sunset and seaside viewpoints.

places.name: Basanavičiaus Street
places.description: A lively promenade full of cafés, shops and coastal atmosphere.

hidden_gems.name: Birutė Hill
hidden_gems.description: A quiet forest hill with mythological significance and peaceful sea views.

hidden_gems.name: Dune Viewpoints South of the Pier
hidden_gems.description: Less crowded dunes offering calm scenery and perfect nature photography spots.

hidden_gems.name: Botanical Garden Trails
hidden_gems.description: Wooded, quiet trails around ponds and gardens near the Amber Museum.

ideas: 🍦 Ice cream strolls on Basanavičiaus Street.
🌞 Calm beach walks on quiet sands.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Buses from Klaipėda run frequently to Palanga.
🚆 Intercity buses connect Palanga with Vilnius, Kaunas and Šiauliai.
🚶 The seaside and Old Town areas are walkable.
🚲 Many forest and dune paths are bike-friendly.

city_events.name: Palanga Smelt Festival
city_events.description: 🎣 Coastal traditions, food tastings and seaside celebrations.

cities.name: Šiauliai

interests.name: Landmarks 🌄
interests.description: The Hill of Crosses is Šiauliai’s most iconic landmark, known for its thousands of crosses placed by visitors over generations. A peaceful, spiritual, and unique cultural site.

interests.name: Urban Culture 🎭
interests.description: Šiauliai’s compact center is filled with street art, cafés, local shops, and cultural corners. A calm but creative Baltic small-city atmosphere.

interests.name: Parks 🌿
interests.description: Green lakeside areas, walking paths, and peaceful parks make Šiauliai relaxing for slow strolls, picnics, and sunset watching.

cities.local_food_tip: Simple Baltic soups, salads and pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Visit the iconic Hill of Crosses → return to town for coffee. Afternoon: Walk through Šiauliai City Center → lunch with light Baltic dishes → explore local art corners. Sunset: Enjoy golden reflections at Talka Lake. Night: Peaceful evening walk through the small, cozy streets.

places.name: Hill of Crosses
places.description: A symbolic and spiritual hill covered with thousands of crosses — unique in the world.

places.name: Šiauliai City Center
places.description: The cultural heart of the city with shops, cafés, murals, and relaxed Baltic atmosphere.

places.name: Talka Lake
places.description: A peaceful lakeside park perfect for sunset views and calm afternoon walks.

places.name: Chaim Frenkel Villa (Exterior)
places.description: Historic villa with beautiful gardens, great for quiet outdoor strolling.

hidden_gems.name: Fox Path (Lapės takas) — Forest Trail
hidden_gems.description: A peaceful nature trail on the edge of Šiauliai — great for quiet forest walks.

hidden_gems.name: Sundial Square
hidden_gems.description: A symbolic square featuring the famous ‘Šiauliai Sun’ sculpture — a local pride point.

hidden_gems.name: Salduvė Park
hidden_gems.description: A quiet, green park with small hills, forest areas and peaceful walking paths.

ideas: 🌼 Fields in bloom near Hill of Crosses.
🚶 Calm nature walks in Salduvė Park.
🌇 Long sunsets across the lakes and fields.
🥧 Cozy bakery visits in the center.
🌞 Snowy open fields near Hill of Crosses.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Regional buses connect Šiauliai with Vilnius, Kaunas and nearby towns.
🚆 Trains run between Šiauliai, Vilnius, Klaipėda and other cities.
🚶 The city center is compact and easily walkable.
📱 Use the Trafi app for local routes and schedules.

city_events.name: Šiauliai Jazz Nights
city_events.description: 🎷 Outdoor evening jazz concerts across the city.

cities.name: Trakai

interests.name: Lakes 🌊
interests.description: Trakai is surrounded by beautiful lakes, the most famous being Lake Galvė. Perfect for peaceful walks, boat rides, photography and lakeside relaxation.

interests.name: Castles 🏰
interests.description: The iconic red-brick Trakai Island Castle sits in the middle of Lake Galvė — one of Lithuania’s most photographed historic sites and a symbol of the region.

interests.name: Nature Walks 🌿
interests.description: Forests, lakeside paths, wooden bridges and calm scenery make Trakai ideal for outdoor walks and slow exploration.

cities.local_food_tip: Light Baltic dishes: veggie soups, salads and pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Visit Trakai Island Castle (exterior) → walk along Lake Galvė → coffee at a lakeside café. Afternoon: Explore the nature trails in Trakai National Park → lunch with light Baltic dishes → stroll through Karaim heritage street. Sunset: Enjoy reflections over Lake Galvė. Night: Quiet lakeside walk under soft lights.

places.name: Trakai Island Castle
places.description: The iconic island castle accessible by a wooden bridge — one of Lithuania’s most famous landmarks.

places.name: Lake Galvė
places.description: A scenic lake surrounding the castle — perfect for photos, boating, and peaceful walks.

places.name: Karaim Street (Karaimų gatvė)
places.description: Historic wooden houses and the cultural center of the Karaim community, unique to Trakai.

places.name: Trakai Historical National Park
places.description: Forests, hills and lakes — ideal for easy nature exploring.

hidden_gems.name: Užutrakis Manor
hidden_gems.description: A lakeside manor with beautiful gardens and castle views across the water.

hidden_gems.name: Varnikai Forest Trail
hidden_gems.description: A wooden boardwalk trail through forest and marshes — quiet, relaxing and scenic.

hidden_gems.name: Trakai Peninsula Castle Ruins
hidden_gems.description: Lesser-known ruins near the lake with peaceful surroundings and historical atmosphere.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Direct buses run from Vilnius to Trakai.
🚆 Train connection Vilnius ↔ Trakai is fast and easy.
🚶 The town and lake area are fully walkable.
🚲 Lakeside cycling routes are very popular in summer.

city_events.name: Trakai Medieval Festival
city_events.description: 🏰 Historical shows on the lake with costumes, music and reenactments.
